expectation: Membrane (junctional) ring on epithelial cells only; common in epithelial or tumour glands and nests, forming honeycomb outlines and glandular or ductal lining, absent from surrounding stroma and immune cells.
observed: A: many cores show bright yellow in glands, ducts and nests, with dark stroma and empty lumens; some cores are nearly negative. B and C: yellow honeycomb membranes on cohesive epithelial cells, with blue nuclei inside the rings and stroma dark. D: continuous chicken-wire cell-edge network.
why: Epithelial-restricted junctional membrane staining that follows glandular architecture and leaves stroma unstained is the expected E-cadherin pattern.
notes: E-cadherin shows crisp membrane rings on epithelial glands and nests with unstained stroma. Pattern is consistent across many cores, and the cores without epithelium are appropriately negative.
